<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z ≈ 100.05. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, subtracting the proton mass (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral mass of about 99.04 Da. The molecular formula that matches this neutral mass most closely is C₄H₅O₂N (exact neutral mass = 99.0320 Da), which predicts a [M+H]⁺ m/z of 100.039 Da, within typical experimental tolerance. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C₄H₅O₂N.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H5O2N</final_answer>
